title: Assert the receiver's raw signed 503 in the response-body-failure test
outcome: The receiver body-failure test in src/tests/federation_rpc.rs (around :119) also inspects the receiver's raw reply: status 503 with a present MAC header. It then fails if the receiver regresses to a headerless 408, which the client deliberately maps to the same 503 with the lease kept, so the existing client-side assertions cannot tell the two apart.
acceptance: Assert the receiver's raw signed 503 in the response-body-failure test is done
